decisions.statement: A part is listed under the name handed for the namespace with it.
The page type a part names is dropped.
Nothing here works a part's own name out of that part's slug.
A part is listed with the definition handed for that part.
A part handed no definition is listed by name alone.
The names are padded to the widest of them so the definitions line up.
The parts are written down sorted by the name each is listed under.
The order the parts were handed in reaches no listing.
A namespace with no part is written down as nothing.

definition: the commands a namespace has, written down for a reader
